answer: Each task is derived from a domain-separated hash of its identifier and a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS beacon pulse, so participants cannot know the challenge when committing and must answer after it is fixed. Commit-reveal checks bind each response to that challenge, thwarting precomputation and offline farming by automated sybil swarms; the pulse does not itself prove unique identities. A nonce might name an orchard, knoll, or mirror, but cannot bias the beacon.
